pin_description: Land Cruiser Prado 150 buying guide: avoid 2009, 2017 (Unsealed 4X4 flags launch-year trucks for airbag recalls and electrical gremlins.) The sweet spot is 2013. Every model year with the reasons and sources.
yt_comment:
Why 2013–15? Those trucks have the first facelift but still run the 3.0 1KD-FTV diesel. It has a timing belt due at 150,000 km, and Unsealed 4X4 recommends servicing the injectors around every 100,000 km, so ask for the receipts.

From June 2015 the 2.8 1GD-FTV took over: a timing chain, but also a DPF. Diesels sold in Australia from October 2015 to April 2020 were part of the DPF class action, so on one of those, have a Toyota dealer check the VIN for the free May 2020 DPF fix. The 2020-on trucks (150 kW, CarPlay) are the most desirable.

Which year is yours?
